card.name: Dose words in interaction dosing limits
card.fires_on: The words dose, exposure(s) and the unit mg right after a number, in drug-interaction text about limiting or adjusting a dose. Most often the mg after 20 in a dose cap.

modes.label: mg after a number
modes.description: The unit mg following a capped or starting dose amount in interaction instructions.
modes.example: In patients receiving darunavir/ritonavir for at least one week, start tadalafil at 20<< mg>> once daily.

modes.description: The nouns dose or exposure(s) in text about drug levels and recommended maximums.
